MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The utility syringes fit my resin work because controlled dispensing supports a task I've already shown interest in.",
    "The threaded magnets offer another way to make removable mounts, building naturally on my use of adhesive tape and hook-and-loop strips.",
    "The Starlock washers add a different fastening option to my repair supplies, complementing my bolts, rivets, and cotter pins."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The wire connectors and decorative printer filament don't connect to a current task in my history; working with tools doesn't mean I need electrical connectors or own a 3D printer.",
    "The pressure gauge needs a specific pressure range and connection to be useful. My caliper and thermometer purchases don't establish that need.",
    "More metric bolts and wood screws are relevant, but I already have overlapping assortments. The two-gallon resin kit also requires a larger project before I'd choose it."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My repeated fastener purchases seem to be taken as a reason to keep offering similar assortments, even when they add little to what I already have.",
    "My workshop interests seem to be stretched into a need for specialized supplies without a clear connection to the jobs I've been doing."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I care about what a new item lets me do beyond my existing supplies, which makes different retention hardware more appealing than another overlapping bolt kit.",
    "A plausible use isn't always an immediate need: larger fasteners, bulk resin, and specialized gauges depend on the project, quantity, and fit."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognize my hands-on repair and fabrication interests, but sometimes confuse useful additions with duplicate supplies or tools for jobs I haven't shown a need to do."
}
